places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Jake joins Augustus drinking on the porch; Augustus teaches the Irishmen to ride and shoot at a cactus; the prime horses are sent back to town to be penned.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande; the Hat Creek house has a porch, wagons and a horse pen

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: The stolen herd grazes near it; Augustus looks across expecting Pedro Flores at dusk and moves the poorer horses upriver.

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Augustus tells Jake to keep the herd from straying back into it; Jake says Gus has caused him more trouble than all its bandits.

places.name: Sabinas
places.note: Augustus had no time there to adjust the Irishmen's stirrups.
places.location_hint: in northern Mexico, within a night's ride of Lonesome Dove

places.name: Montana
places.note: Call is hiring cowboys for the drive there; Jake regrets suggesting it and fears scalping.

places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: Jake worries a lawman from there may come and take him to hang if he stays.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Jake fears that staying in Texas likely means hanging.

places.name: San Francisco
places.note: Jake worries Lorie will hold him to taking her there; Augustus teases him about it.

places.name: California
places.note: Jake idly talks of drifting off there with Lorena.

places.name: Ireland
places.note: Allen pines for his young wife Sary, whom he left there.

groups.label: Augustus's horse guard
groups.hint: moving about a hundred poorer horses north and upriver from near Lonesome Dove at dusk, watching for Pedro Flores

groups.label: Prime horse drovers
groups.hint: taking the best stock back to town to pen
